hypothesis: A global encoder that distinguishes support and load interfaces may transfer displacement response better than coordinates alone, even though query-local BC indicators are already available.
prior_evidence: Shared fields transfer poorly despite excellent independent fitting; query-local geometry yields limited gains.
Gradient supervision repairs P1 derivatives but trades off displacement; the training-calibrated weight gives mean improvement without worst-case preservation.
Absolute length already exists in original25 channel24 and varies only178.10-185.28mm; duplicate size input is unjustified and size-prefactor control is deferred.
Input-only role coverage found support and load nodes in all45 existing1024-point geometry clouds; no resampling is needed.
dataset: Original DeepJEB v1.0, official CSV GRID coordinates -> H5 vertices
excluded: Final5CAD fields and dia labels; no new test or load-span probe

input.query: original25 BC/material + existing13 local geometry; force/moment slots7:13 zeroed for load-linear basis
input.global_cloud: Same1024 normalized xyz, mask and node indices as the current gradient baseline; append2 target-independent binary role channels
input.support_union: any original25 input features0:6 is constrained
input.source: Aligned canonical ver input features at the exact existing cloud node_indices, no fields or targets
input.zero_control: Set both role slots to0 before PointNet; retain5-channel architecture
input.actual: Use both binary role slots before the same PointNet
input.load_independence: One role cloud per CAD reused for all reference loads; verify role fields agree across known-load input metadata/arrays already loaded by training

common_model.capacity_policy: Both zero and actual include the same additional64parameters; old3-channel baseline is contextual evidence only and cannot be reused as the matched control

common_training.u_loss: train-case-relative MSE with existing commonzero-centered train-onlyu RMS
common_training.strain_loss: Existing physical-corner P1 volume/Frobenius-normalized training target; proxy derived from trainingu, not solverGTstrain
common_training.calibration: Frozen notes/geobc_gradient_calibration.json; no weight sweep or recalibration
common_training.best_checkpoint: Known-load validation displacement case mean only, unchanged
common_training.control_checks: Matchedinitialparameters/scalers/sampling/cloudcoordinates/masks/nodeindices; only role input differs. NativePointNet and all decoderparameters require finite nonzero gradients.

comparison.reference: New5-channel zero-role control at its u-selected checkpoint
comparison.candidate: New5-channel actual-role candidate at its u-selected checkpoint
comparison.metrics: All original FEM nodes; physical displacement vector relativeL2, worst-case, pooled; same P1 nodal tensor Frobenius diagnostics for train/validation
comparison.if_pass: Repeat the same matched pair at seed2027 before teacher/stress expansion; finaltest remains isolated
comparison.if_fail: Use train-versus-validation differences to choose one smaller diagnostic. No automatic loss/capacity sweep or second seed.

limitations: Support union discards individual constrainedDOFs and patch identity/topology; this control tests only2 coarse global role channels.
Existing sparse surface-node clouds are not uniform-area samples and role presence alone does not ensure every interface patch is represented.
P1 corner recovery is a proxy on TETRA10 geometry, not exact quadratic or exported solver strain.
Developmentvalidation is adaptively reused across previous hypotheses; final5CAD fields remain excluded. HistoricalHash50 use of finalCADs is documented.
This composition of existing hash/PointNet/gradient supervision is a candidate baseline, not an established new algorithm or generalization success.
execution: One serial GPU queue; newsource modules preserve every completed experiment's frozen code and checkpoints
